findings.summary: Actual SDK/provider unknown error text reaches public UI rather than a fixed public diagnostic.
findings.source: Unmodified SDK1.1.8 propagates the synthetic original-provider Error message after a single mutation attempt.
findings.path: Actual Wallet.act -> official SDK -> actual ui.run(01) or shell.run(05) -> status/notice/trail textContent
findings.control: 01 only redacts isolated64hex strings; arbitrary nonhex diagnostic strings remain.05 forwards Error.message directly.
findings.evidence: All4 actual Wallet+SDK+UI integration cases display the fictional sentinel; no synthetic DOM/setup failure. Pending remains unknown and no extra mutation is forwarded.
findings.counterevidence: No real credential was accessed or observed. Random synthetic RevealVault salt was neither stored nor displayed in this concrete run; do not claim a demonstrated salt/real-secret leak.
findings.recommendation: Use fixed or explicitly whitelisted UNVERIFIED public errors for SDK/RPC/provider exceptions; do not dump message/cause/raw response. Preserve original pending/hash and never resend. Test actual UI read/write/resume failure paths.

findings.path: SDK formatter -> assertSDK leaders.length>1 -> WalletSession.observe -> pending=null
findings.evidence: Both05 actual Wallet+unmodified SDK cases complete and clear pending; both01 strict cases reject/retain the same supplied[] evidence.
findings.counterevidence: Raw sender/hash/target/value0/FINALIZED/NORMAL/majority/unique-success requirements remain mandatory; a wrong or failed raw transaction is not accepted.
findings.recommendation: For supplied SDK leader evidence require exactly one successful leader; distinguish absent evidence from explicit[], validator-only, malformed, multiple or failed lists. Add actual SDK plus raw paired packet regressions.
